description.value:
Goblins, colloquially referred to as Gobs or Gobbies, are a race of Beastmen found in most regions of Vana'diel, known for their adaptability and craftsmanship.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Goblins gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Strength.
  • Size: Goblins are Small creatures.
  • Type: Goblins are humanoids with the goblin subtype.
  • Base Speed: Goblins have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Common and Goblin. Goblins with high Intelligence scores can choose almost any language.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Craftsman: Goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal, wood, cloth or stone.
  • Field Medic: Goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on Heal checks, treated as a class skill.
  • Goblin's Unique Handle on Things: Goblins are proficient with short swords and hand axes.
  • Master Tinker: Goblins gain a +1 bonus on Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering) checks, and are treated as proficient with any non-exotic weapon they have personally crafted.
  • Silver Tongued: Goblins gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks, and can shift a creature's attitude up to three steps with a successful Diplomacy check.
  • Thug Life: Goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on the steal combat maneuver.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Goblin Punch: Once per day, goblins can cast Goblin Punch using their Intelligence modifier for the saving throw and their level as caster level.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-light Vision: A goblin can see twice as far as a hume in dim light.
